messages:
rachel: Quick shout 161; indie LAN tonight? Thinking 'Indie Gauntlet'   7:30pm in the mezz. Bring controllers, laptops, vibes.
ben: In. I can toss my Steam library on a laptop. Has Dont Starve Together and Move or Die if peeps want chaos.
kelly: I'll bring my Switch Lite and a pro controller. Also a tiny travel router.
tom: Ill be late (dinner plans). Can we reserve a station for 4-player local?
aisha: Save me a spot! I'm bringing candles (jk) but I can bring USB fans and a multi-USB charger. Also down for a tiny prize (gift card?).
hardware-bot: inventory check: available projectors: 1, HDMI adapters: 3, ethernet cables: 4. Reserve? Reply yes/no.
rachel: Yes please reserve the projector and 2 HDMI adapters. We'll need ethernet for at least 3 machines.
ben: I'll bring an extra 5-port switch and 2 cat6s. Also can pick up one veggie pizza en route. Anyone want specific toppings? :pizza:
kelly: Pepperoni + olives please. No anchovies. :grimacing:
tom: I'll handle drinks. Sodas + sparkling water ok?
aisha: Perfect. Quick poll: structured time slots? 7:30-9:00 "speedruns" then 9:00-11:30 "chaos"?
rachel: Love the split. Speedruns sounds fun; I'll run a short leaderboard. 
ben: Can we stream the final speedrun? I can bring my capture card.
kelly: FYI my dock is at home but I have handhelds. If we need extra controllers I can borrow from front-desk loaners.
hardware-bot: projector reserved. Please sign equipment waiver: tiny.cc/office-gear-waiver
aisha: Also reminder: label controllers and chargers. Last event someones PS pad never returned. :cry:
tom: noted. I'll slap my sticker on everything.
rachel: Okay team 161; see you at 7:30. If traffic hits ping here. I'll post a quick map thread in #office-ops for mezz access. :sparkles:
